cultural.vision_reason: A traditional man's hip-length cotton shirt with embroidered V-neck opening, stand-up collar, and gathered cuffs — a garment type consistent with Csángó/Hungarian folk dress from Romania.

physical.title: shirt
physical.summary: A man's shirt, hip length.  Made of pale blue tabby woven cotton cloth.  Bodice and upper sleeves tightly gathered to form neckline.  'V'-shaped centre front opening embroidered in blanket stitch using orange woollen yarn (with synthetic).  This yarn also used for solid embroidery on stand-up collar and zigzag patterning below.   (Collar and cuffs lined with natural cream tabby linen (?) cloth.)  Neckline fastened with red plied cotton cord.  Both top and bottom of sleeve ends tightly gathered; latter onto cuff with orange embroidery.  (Right cuff (as worn) has block of pink/red embroidery too.)  Oversewing with orange yarn of all seams (save centre back).  Hemline raw, except front, which is a selvedge. Stained.
